source.title: Call for Applicants - WSOT Leader (May 2022)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT) Leader.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 4 - 6 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong technical expertise
* Good communication
* Ability to digest long documents in complex English
* Detail-oriented
* Project management experience

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until **May 19th, 2022, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).
<!-- break -->
**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**
 
1. Brief personal introduction.
2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
3. Ambitions as the WSOT Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WSOT can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2022.13](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.13%20-%20Sports%20Organization%20Team.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 体育组织团队招募负责人（2022 年 5 月）
translation.content:
WCA 将任命一位新的体育组织团队（WSOT）负责人。

申请人应能完成 24 个月任期，并平均每周至少投入 4–6 小时处理团队事务。我们希望申请人具备：

* 扎实的专业技术能力。
* 良好的沟通能力。
* 能够理解篇幅长、英文表达复杂的文档。
* 注重细节。
* 项目管理经验。

申请截止时间为 **2022 年 5 月 19 日 23:59 UTC**。有意者请私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。
<!-- break -->
**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：**

1. 简短的个人介绍。
2. 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
3. 担任 WCA 体育组织团队负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WSOT 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2022.13](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.13%20-%20Sports%20Organization%20Team.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将通过投票选出新负责人，并按照 [WCA 议案 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) 第 4 节，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
